page_title: ARS 2-1 TOT | Arsenal v Tottenham Hotspur 15/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' OFF THE POST! Pedro Porro (Tottenham) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
90+4' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) fires a volley towards goal, but the ball sails well wide of the left post.
90+2' The referee has issued a yellow card to Gabriel (Arsenal).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
87' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Declan Rice is replaced by Mikel Merino (Arsenal).
87' Myles Lewis-Skelly will be replaced by Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal).
87' A yellow card is awarded to Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal).
85' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Tottenham.
83' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
78' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Richarlison (Tottenham) replaces Heung-Min Son.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kieran Tierney (Arsenal) will replace Leandro Trossard.
74' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Martin Odegaard (Arsenal), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
74' The attendance is 60287.
73' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Antonin Kinsky stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
73' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
70' The resulting corner from Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is cleared by the defence.
67' James Maddison (Tottenham) misses a big chance as his shot goes wide of the left post.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Arsenal.
61' It is time for a substitution. Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is on for Raheem Sterling.
59' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

57' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
53' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is quickest inside the box and jumps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it flies just wide of the right post.
52' The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
51' Half-chance! James Maddison (Tottenham) plays a pass into the box, but David Raya reacts well to snuff out the attack.
50' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
46' Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
46' Ange Postecoglou has made a change at the break. James Maddison has come on in place of Yves Bissouma (Tottenham).
46' The game is over for Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham). Brennan Johnson comes on for the second half.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' 2 - 1 Goal! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) takes a short pass from Martin Odegaard in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
43' Simon Hooper shows the yellow card to Kai Havertz (Arsenal) for a heavy challenge.
40' 1 - 1 Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
40' Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' The ball is cleared after Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' Arsenal fail to score from a corner as Antonin Kinsky (Tottenham) leaps to collect the ball.

35' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
34' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to Arsenal.
33' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is able to continue to play.
33' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) is flagged for offside.
31' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
25' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded David Raya. He makes it 0:1.
25' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Tottenham.
24' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom right corner, but David Raya keeps it out with an amazing save.
23' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
22' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
21' Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
19' A corner kick by Arsenal is thwarted by the well prepared Antonin Kinsky (Tottenham).
17' A tremendous drive by Kai Havertz (Arsenal) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Antonin Kinsky makes a brilliant save.
17' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

17' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
14' A pass from Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) is intercepted by Antonin Kinsky and the move breaks down.
13' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
13' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) inside the box.
12' Declan Rice (Arsenal) whips in a cross from the corner, but Antonin Kinsky is well positioned and punches the ball away.
11' Arsenal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

11' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball. Arsenal will take a corner kick.

10' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simon Hooper with no other option than to blow for a foul. Arsenal get a free kick.
9' Arsenal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
8' Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball goes out for a corner. Arsenal can continue in their attacking effort.
6' A cross from a corner kick by Arsenal is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

5' Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.
1' The first half has started.
Tottenham will kick-off.
Simon Hooper got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
